in_marathi.name: Prasun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prasun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prasun means 'Sun Ray'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prasna', which means 'to ask'. The name Prasun is a reference to the sun, which is often referred to as the giver of light and knowledge. This name is believed to bestow the qualities of radiance, gentleness, and warmth upon the bearer.
